selection.fit_role: construction and alias-template integrity plus pre-calibration descriptor sanity reporting only; FIT never selects a parameter
selection.grid_iteration: nested in CALIBRATION_GRID_ORDER using each listed value order
selection.raw_grid_query_identity: grid-major then query_id lexicographic; exact (grid_index, query_id) cross-product
selection.scope: FULL_BELIEF on the 16 CALIBRATION episodes only
selection.selection: lexicographically maximize correct_next_edge_accuracy, then localisation_top3; minimize normalized_graph_distance_regret, then false_confident_localisation_rate, then abstention_rate; exact ties select the first grid tuple

claims.positive_wording: JEPA place belief under oracle topology

filter.abstention: abstain iff -sum(p*log(p))/log(number_of_nodes) is strictly greater than the calibrated normalized-entropy threshold; equality does not abstain
filter.action_conditioned_graph_kernel: allocate action_compatible_edge_probability uniformly over compatible outgoing edges and the remainder uniformly over incompatible outgoing edges; if either set is empty, redistribute its mass over the nonempty set; a node with no outgoing edge stays at itself
filter.current_frame: observation likelihood only; no carried prior
filter.fixed_window: for the latest four observations and three executed transitions (or the available prefix), score candidate graph paths of length four, sum path scores by final node from a fresh uniform prior, renormalize, and commit the highest-probability final node; carry no belief
filter.full_belief: retain and renormalize every episode-local node after every update
filter.map_filter: after every update retain only the deterministic MAP node with mass one
filter.no_action_consistency: replace action-conditioned graph kernel by uniform outgoing-edge mass
filter.no_observation_likelihood: replace observation likelihood by the all-ones likelihood
filter.oracle: unit mass on the registered true node
filter.prediction: predicted[j] = sum_i belief[i] * transition(action, j | i)
filter.prior: uniform over every episode-local oracle node before query_index 0
filter.ranking_tie_break: descending probability, then lexicographically smaller node_id
filter.shuffled_action_history: for each length-L history (L>=2), set shift=1+(int(SHA256(query_id)[:8],16) mod (L-1)) and persist mapping[j]=(j+shift) mod L, a deterministic complete rotation derangement; observations, graph, query order, and true labels remain fixed
filter.top_k_belief: after every update retain the three highest nodes and renormalize

formulas.aggregation: query macro-average (equivalently episode-balanced because every episode has eight queries), plus per-family, per-episode, and per-depth-since-last-unambiguous-observation
formulas.brier: mean sum_node (probability - one_hot_true)^2; no class-count division
formulas.correct_abstention: abstained condition-specific-unresolved queries divided by condition-specific-unresolved queries; null if none
formulas.correct_next_edge: nonabstained selected route port equals the true node's registered oracle next port
formulas.ece: 10 equal-width confidence bins on max node probability; left-closed/right-open except final includes 1.0; empty bins contribute zero
formulas.false_confident: wrong MAP and not abstained, divided by all queries
formulas.false_loop_closure: wrong selected node in the query's oracle prior-visited-node set while the true node differs and not abstained, divided by all queries; descriptive frozen-graph association proxy only, never an actual merge or loop-closure mutation
formulas.false_place_merge: wrong selected node in the true node's registered alias group and not abstained, divided by all queries
formulas.regret: for the selected port at the true node, (selected successor distance - best successor distance)/(worst successor distance - best successor distance); denominator-zero is 0; invalid ports and abstentions are 1; clamp to [0,1]
formulas.route_distribution: sum nonterminal node posterior mass by that node's unique shortest-path next port to the oracle goal
formulas.route_selection: choose the largest posterior route mass, ties by PORT_LABEL_ORDER; persist as edge witness the oracle-best edge of the highest-posterior node voting for that port, ties by node_id; if all mass is terminal, selected port and edge are null
formulas.route_top3: true oracle port is among the three highest route-distribution ports; ties use PORT_LABEL_ORDER
formulas.wrong_turn: nonabstained selected port differs from the true oracle port, divided by all queries

next_decisions.SHORT_HISTORY_SUFFICIENT: construct longer episodes with greater alias-separation depth before persistent-memory work
next_decisions.TOPOLOGICAL_FULL_BELIEF_SIGNAL: run conditional Stage B with FULL_BELIEF as the strongest memory condition
next_decisions.TOPOLOGICAL_MAP_SUFFICIENT: run conditional Stage B with MAP_FILTER as the strongest memory condition

stage_a_beliefs.jsonl/observation_simila.shape: one value per full graph node

observation_likelihood.score: after token-wise LayerNorm and L2 normalization, aligned-token cosine for the matched viewpoint, then arithmetic mean over all 768 spatial tokens

aliasing.caveat: This is a constructed perceptual-aliasing challenge set, not an estimate of natural alias prevalence.
aliasing.condition_specific_unresolved: for one condition and query, at least two graph paths remain exactly consistent with that condition's permitted registered alias tokens, observation window/carry state, and action history, end at different nodes, and require different next ports
aliasing.eligibility_inputs: exact geometry, immutable oracle graph, exact renderer, registered alias tokens, action-compatible paths, and reachability only; never V-JEPA/model outcomes

families.LOOP_ALIAS: revisited locally indistinguishable loop locations require sequence evidence
families.MIRRORED_JUNCTION: matched junction views have different goal connectivity and required next ports
families.REPEATED_CORRIDOR: at least two locally identical corridor segments at different graph locations require different next ports
families.REPEATED_ROOM: identical local room layout and landmarks have different neighborhoods and routes

aliasing.identifiability: the current frame is ambiguous, while the complete registered observation/action history distinguishes the true node at every registered query; CURRENT_FRAME and FIXED_WINDOW remain condition-specifically unresolved while FULL_BELIEF is resolved
aliasing.leakage_forbidden: family-ID texture/palette, waypoint, action schedule, camera, node index, goal pose, and query-depth leakage; paired aliases match camera yaw and local pose
aliasing.oracle_admissibility: every query binds all physically executable and oracle-admissible outgoing edges at its true node, requires at least two, and includes the shortest-path next edge; these labels are evidence only and never localisation inputs
aliasing.phase_a_memory_provenance: every posterior-bank node binds its first Phase-A teacher encounter and keyframe; the ordered traversal persists observation occurrence, arrival edge, executed action, and timestamp, with consecutive executable teacher edges
aliasing.query_capture_disjointness: each Phase-C query capture has a distinct occurrence identity and later timestamp than all Phase-A captures while binding the same registered pixel template/hash as its exact aliases
aliasing.required_per_query: the true node belongs to a registered alias group containing at least two distinct nodes, including a node whose oracle next port differs
aliasing.selection: complete eligible population first, deterministic hash order, then roles; no post-feature replacement

predecessor_result_binding.exact_conclusion: Static geometry visible in the current V-JEPA representation is sufficient for the tested non-greedy local route decisions. Future rollout is not justified for this task.
predecessor_result_binding.scientific_interpretation: current visual geometry solved the local challenge; true futures used candidate-specific information but added no registered value over the reactive visual ranker

prior_panel_exclusion_authority.comparison: exact set intersection for text/numeric identities plus SHA256(current scene_id) against registered predecessor scene hashes
prior_panel_exclusion_authority.projection_algorithm: SHA-256 of the canonical compact-JSON sorted-unique array with no trailing LF

precedence: SHORT_HISTORY_SUFFICIENT when FIXED_WINDOW is within 0.03 edge accuracy, 0.05 top3 recall, and 0.03 regret of the strongest absolute-gate-passing persistent condition
otherwise TOPOLOGICAL_MAP_SUFFICIENT when MAP passes the absolute gate and FULL has no material value over MAP
otherwise TOPOLOGICAL_FULL_BELIEF_SIGNAL when FULL passes absolute, current-margin, and MAP-increment gates

otherwise TOPOLOGICAL_PERSISTENT_GATE_UNRESOLVED when any persistent condition passes absolute but none of the preceding registered decisions applies (including TOP_K-only); fail closed and do not authorize Stage B

stage_b.episodes: 16 fresh executions derived one-for-one from development-heldout scenes

execution_policy.belief_update: never reuse Stage-A belief rows: CURRENT_FRAME uses only the fresh likelihood; strongest MAP/FULL carries its own Stage-B posterior through every constituent action actually executed by the preceding macro transition; a registered NO_OP is an exact identity transition with no transition-noise mixing; ORACLE is unit mass on the actual node

control_history_evidence.continuity: post-decision command/history equals the next decision's ranker input

execution_policy.decision_unit: one decision is one registered query choice, not one constituent graph edge; the oracle therefore reaches the goal in exactly eight correct choice decisions even though the registered path contains more than eight constituent edges
execution_policy.distance: remaining distance is exact frozen-graph shortest distance to goal; row progress is distance_before-distance_after; executed distance is the sum of every persisted constituent edge cost. Oracle path distance is the exact full registered leave-and-return cycle: prelude plus all eight correct query macros, never the zero graph distance from the initial goal node to itself
execution_policy.edge_selection: derive posterior route mass and its edge witness exactly as Stage A; entropy abstention executes nothing. Otherwise retrieve the belief-witness edge's stored relative waypoint; the witness may belong to a wrong place hypothesis and is never replaced by the true edge
execution_policy.fresh_observation: at every decision render a fresh RGB occurrence at the actual node, bind its pixel SHA, and evaluate the frozen V-JEPA target encoder; exact-byte token-cache reuse is permitted only when keyed by that SHA and the frozen encoder binding
execution_policy.initial_state: each heldout graph binds stage_b_start_node_id to its observed goal node; all three conditions independently start at that exact occurrence with an empty visited set and a fresh uniform filter prior
execution_policy.local_ranker: for a nonabstained decision with a route witness and a nonempty preregistered geometry mask, call the frozen current-visual ranker exactly once, score all twelve candidates, then select the highest score among the geometry-derived ORACLE-admissible candidate indices with candidate-index tie-breaking. Pass only fresh current tokens, stored waypoint, actual prior command/control history, and the frozen bank; never pass future tokens or route/contact/oracle labels into the score computation
execution_policy.nonmovement: entropy abstention, absence of a posterior route witness, or an empty preregistered local oracle-admissibility mask keeps the actual node fixed, executes NO_OP, calls no local ranker, records zero distance/progress, and reobserves unless the two-decision nonmovement limit is reached
execution_policy.prelude: before decision zero, execute the prospectively registered unbudgeted deterministic stage_b_prelude_edge_ids from the observed goal through prefix, anchor, branch marker, and alias tail to stage_b_decision_start_node_id/query zero; persist and process every fresh observation and action. CURRENT resets at query zero, MAP/FULL carries the complete prelude posterior, and ORACLE is one-hot on the actual node
execution_policy.recovery: after any wrong-port return or nonmovement decision, recovery remains pending until a later correct-port macro advances to the next registered query or goal with positive geodesic progress; only that later row records recovery=true
execution_policy.terminal_precedence: GOAL_REACHED after transition; otherwise NONMOVEMENT_LIMIT at two consecutive nonmovement decisions; otherwise DECISION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED after decision 15; otherwise continue
execution_policy.transition: an acting decision executes the actual edge preregistered for the selected local candidate, then automatically executes the deterministic shortest registered constituent-edge path to the next query (or goal) after a correct port, or through the complete wrong branch and back to the same query after a wrong port. Both paths and all twelve candidate outcomes are registered in the query ledger before scoring; shortest-path ties use the lexicographically smallest complete edge-id sequence. Every constituent edge, action, target node, cost, observation, and filter update is persisted

stage_b.outcomes: goal reach, edge accuracy, wrong turns, path efficiency, replans, recovery, false merge/loop proxies, abstentions, geodesic progress, descriptive contact/stuck, and latency
stage_b.pipeline: localize, choose next oracle-graph edge, retrieve its stored relative waypoint, apply oracle admissibility, rank the frozen local candidate bank with the frozen current-visual ranker, execute a short prefix, reobserve, and repeat
stage_b.positive_wording: JEPA topological navigation under oracle topology and oracle admissibility

stage_b_metric_formulas.edge_accuracy: nonabstained selected port equals registered true next port, divided by all decisions
stage_b_metric_formulas.false_confident_wrong_turn: persisted nonabstained confident wrong-turn count divided by all decisions
stage_b_metric_formulas.goal_reach: terminal goal_reached, summed over the 16 executions
stage_b_metric_formulas.oracle_reach_fraction: strongest-memory goals reached divided by oracle-place goals reached; zero if oracle reaches none
stage_b_metric_formulas.path_efficiency: per execution goal_reached * min(1, oracle_path_distance/(prelude_distance+sum macro executed_distance)), then mean over all 16; zero when not reached
stage_b_metric_formulas.wrong_turn: executed candidate port differs from registered true next port, divided by all decisions
